description: Illustrative surface-coverage evaluation for one deep-mapped framework instance under the kye.surface_class.v1 registry. A deep-mapped framework REQUIRES page + deep-store + search; a registered framework requires none (state-aware honesty — a not-yet-deep-mapped framework has zero surface requirements, so coverage is never faked).

resolved.page: present — public compliance page for the framework
resolved.deep-store: present — per-requirement deep-store manifest for the framework
resolved.search: present — indexed in the derived search surface

contrast_registered_state.note: A registered (not-yet-deep-mapped) framework has ZERO surface requirements — forcing a page would fake coverage.
